reply_text:
Nobody has labelled them. They are simply what was left after every earlier pass closed the problems it could, so none is easy. Judging from the problem text and what earlier attempts reported, I'd sort them like this:

| Problem | Topic | My read | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| m99A06 | fixed point for a convolution equation in L¹ | probably close | last attempt: contraction estimates compile, "only closed-ball fixed-point assembly remains" |
| m99A01 | extremals of a quadratic functional | close, but may be a statement defect | last attempt was building a bump-function refutation, like m95A03 and m02A05 |
| m97A06 | pendulum-type functional, Euler–Lagrange and conserved energy | medium | 13 attempts, 700-line partial file, one `sorry` |
| m98A06 | extrema of ∫(y′² − y²) | medium | 3 bridges open; same integration-by-parts material as m97A06 |
| m99A02 | is −log^{1/3}\|x\| in H¹ of a disc | medium | antiderivative and limits compile; 2 bridges open |
| m98J05 | Fourier transform and the heat equation | medium to hard | one bridge closed; needs approximate-identity convergence and differentiation under the integral |
| m99J06 | H₀¹(0,1), weak versus strong problem | hard | needs Sobolev space theory Mathlib lacks; attempts are still at basic setup |
| m95A03 | Sturm–Liouville minimizer | hard | needs existence for the boundary-value problem plus the fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations |
| m98A04 | convolution of a distribution with a test function | hard | distribution theory built from scratch; 12 attempts, still on seminorm estimates |
| m98J02 | convolution of distributions, a PDE | hard | same missing distribution theory; 2 bridges open |

Attempt counts are from before the build mode existed, when seats stopped at 6 attempts or so, so they understate how far each could go.

The five "stopped" problems were in the hard group by the same measure, and four of them closed once the seats were told to build the missing theory, in 4 to 33 attempts each. So I'd expect the first five here to land in a build run and the last four to cost roughly what m02J02 is costing now.

m99A01 is worth checking by hand before spending attempts on it, since a seat was refuting it rather than proving it.
